name: Suzuki RG500 Gamma / RG250 Gamma
engine: 498 cc square-four or 247 cc twin two-stroke, liquid-cooled, multiple carbs
intro: Suzuki's GP-replica two-strokes. Never sold new in the US, so most here are imports. Expensive parts and careful work.

A: These were never sold new in the US. Make sure the title and import paperwork match the VIN before you put money in.
B: A two-stroke with leaking crank seals runs lean and can seize. Get the seals checked before riding hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
